description:
Arkanoid Breakout Orchestrator is an ERC-8004 compliant AI Agent on Base Network specialized in Arkanoid and Breakout style games, brick breaking mechanics, power-up management, strategic paddle control, high-score optimization and multi-level gaming orchestration.

It supports X402 payment operations, on-chain score tracking, Base Builder activity monitoring, GM Chain interactions, ERC-8004 & ERC-8021 identity management, and SIWA signing processes. The agent provides intelligent gameplay automation, optimal brick destruction strategies, power-up automation, and seamless multi-level game management.
